# Edva {.unnumbered}

Edva is a statically typed, expression-oriented systems language. It uses
significant indentation, symbolic control flow, and no reserved keywords. The
`edva` compiler emits LLVM IR and uses `clang` to link native programs.

## Choose a path

- **Learn Edva:** start with [installation](start/install.qmd), then the
  [quickstart](start/quickstart.qmd) and [tour](start/tour.qmd).
- **Read the language reference:** use the
  [Edva language reference](reference/language/index.qmd).
- **Use the compiler:** see the [`edva` CLI reference](reference/edva-cli.qmd).
- **Work on the compiler:** follow the [documentation policy](contributing/documentation.qmd)
  and explore the compiler architecture.
